scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:tailwind
scripts.__build:tailwind:
for f in src/*.scss; do
  filename=$(basename "$f" .scss) 
  NODE_ENV=production tailwindcss -i "$f" -o "../../static/css/${filename}.css" --minify 
done
scripts.__start:
NODE_ENV=development ; for f in src/*.scss; do
  filename=$(basename "$f" .scss) 
 tailwindcss -i "$f" -o "../../static/css/${filename}.css" --watch &
done
